tr: Woman: Do you have a dog at home? / Man: Yes, two.
Man: Is the market close? / Woman: Yes, it's close. You can walk there.
Woman: Is your place far? / Man: Not far. It's around here.
Woman: Are you hungry? / Man: Yes, I want to eat.
Woman: Which letter is this? / Man: It's ก ไก่.
Man: Is the word ขาว (white) written with ข ไข่ or ค ควาย? / Woman: With ข ไข่.
Woman: Is the word สี (color) written with ส เสือ or ซ โซ่? / Man: With ส เสือ.
Woman: Is the word คน (person) written with ค ควาย or ข ไข่? / Man: With ค ควาย.
Man: How do you read this letter? / Woman: ง งู.
Woman: Is the word รัก (love) written with ร เรือ or ล ลิง? / Man: With ร เรือ.
Man: How do I get to the island? / Woman: You take a boat.
Woman: Where are the keys? / Man: On the table.
Man: Where are the kids? / Woman: Outside.
Woman: Where do you study Thai? / Man: At a school in Bangkok.
Man: Hello, Malee. / Woman: Hello, Somchai.
Man: Here's your coffee. / Woman: Thank you.
Man: Sorry! / Woman: That's OK.
Woman: Hello, Ton. How are you? / Man: I'm fine. And you?
Man: This is my friend John. / Woman: Nice to meet you.
Woman: Do you have an older sister? / Man: Yes, just one.
Man: Are you seeing anyone? / Woman: Yes, I am.
Woman: Who's that? / Man: My friend. His name is Ton.
Woman: What does your dad do? / Man: My dad is a doctor.
Man: What's your name? / Woman: My name is Jane.
Woman: Where are you from? / Man: I'm from America.
Man: What do you do? / Woman: I'm a nurse.
Woman: Can you speak Thai? / Man: Yes, I can speak a little Thai.
Man: How much is it altogether? / Woman: Two hundred baht altogether.
Woman: How much is the coffee? / Man: Fifty baht.
Man: How old are you? / Woman: Twenty-one.
Man: How many people? / Woman: Three.
Woman: What would you like? / Man: Two coffees.
Woman: Which one would you like? / Man: That one.
Woman: Two bottles of water, please. / Man: Sure.
Woman: Excuse me, one shrimp fried rice, please. / Server: Sure. Spicy?
Man: Can you eat spicy food? / Woman: No, I can't. Not spicy for me, please.
Man: Excuse me, check, please. / Server: Sure, that's 250 baht.
Are you thirsty? / Very. Could I have some plain water?
Server: For here or to go? / Man: To go.
Man: I'm allergic to peanuts. Does the papaya salad have peanuts? / Woman: It does, but we can leave them out.
Server: What would you like? / Man: One Thai iced tea, please.
Man: My parents have a big house in Chiang Mai. / Really? Can I come visit?
Woman: Whose bag is this? / Man: It's mine. Thank you.
Is this one more expensive? / A little, but it's prettier.
Man: I love Thai food. / Woman: Me too.
Is Thai hard? / Not hard, but you have to listen a lot.
Man: What time is it now? / Woman: 3 p.m.
Are you free tomorrow? / I am. Where are we going?
Have you eaten yet? / Yes, I have.
Where are you now? / I'm on my way. I'll be there in ten minutes.
Shall we go to the market this Saturday? / Sure. What time?
Woman: Excuse me, where's the bathroom? / Man: It's at the back.
Man: Is the market near? / Woman: Yes, it's a five-minute walk.
Woman: Which way is the hotel? / Man: Go straight, then turn left at the traffic light.
Man: Is there a 7-Eleven around here? / Woman: Yes, it's across from the bank.
Can I walk to the temple? / No, it's very far. Better take a taxi.
Man: To the airport, please. / Driver: Sure, hop in.
Woman: Can you use the meter? / Driver: Sure.
Woman: How much to Sukhumvit? / Driver: 200 baht.
Man: Stop here, please. / Driver: OK, that's 120 baht.
Woman: Do I have to change to get to Silom? / Man: Yes, change at Siam.
Woman: How much is this shirt? / Man: 300 baht.
Man: Can you lower the price? / Woman: OK, 250 baht.
Woman: Can I try on these pants? / Man: Sure, the fitting room is at the back.
Man: Can I pay by QR code? / Woman: Yes, the QR code is right here.
Woman: What can I get you? / Man: I'm just looking, thanks.
Woman: What's wrong? / Man: I have a bad headache.
Are you coming to work today? / Man: No, I'm sick.
Woman: Where's a pharmacy? / Man: Next to the 7-Eleven.
Woman: My child has a fever. Do you have any medicine? / Pharmacist: Yes. Take it after meals.
Are you tired? / Very. Let me rest a bit.
Man: Where are you off to? / Woman: To the market.
Woman: What's this? / Man: It's durian.
Man: Do you understand? / Woman: Yes, thank you.
Man: Sorry, could you say that again? / Woman: Sure.
Woman: What's the best way to get to Khao San Road? / Man: Take the bus.
Which one do you like? / Woman: I like this one.
Man: I'm hungry. Shall we go eat? / Woman: Let's go. I'm hungry too.
More? / Man: No thanks, I'm full.
Woman: Where have you been? / Man: Just to the market.
Woman: Are these pants too tight? / A little. Want to try a bigger pair?
Man: Go ahead and eat, don't be shy. / Woman: Thank you.
Man: Excuse me! Could I see the menu? / Server: Sure.
You speak Thai really well. / Oh no, not really. (man answering)
That's really good! / Thank you. I still have a lot to learn. (woman answering)
You look good today. / Thanks, you too.
How's the food? / Everything is delicious.
Please, come in. / Your home is so welcoming.
This is my daughter. / She's so cute. How old is she?
You're a great dancer. / I'm not good yet.
You look beautiful today. / Thank you. You're a sweet talker. (woman answering)
You look really handsome today. / Really? Thank you. (man answering)
You have really beautiful eyes. / Thank you. They're like my mom's. (woman answering)
I like you. (man) / I like you too. (woman)
I like you. (woman) / Really? I'm so happy. (man)
I miss you. / I miss you too.
Want to go for a coffee? / Sure, let's go!
Are you free this Saturday? / I am. Where should we go?
Are you free tonight? / Sorry, I'm really not free.
Can I have your LINE? / Sure!
Are you single? / Still single. And you?
Want to get something to eat? / Thanks, but I'm seeing someone. (woman answering)
I like you. (man) / Thank you, but let's just be friends.
You're the cutest. / Do you say that to everyone?
Will you be my partner? / Let me think about it.
I feel at ease with you. / Me too. (man answering)
It's great to see you. / I'm glad too. (woman answering)
I had a great time today. / I want to see you again.
Let me know when you get home. / Will do. Sweet dreams.
You're really cute. / You're cute too.
